name: Clay Seed Coating
description: Encases seed in clay to delay germination until conditions are right. Used in seed balls and staggered planting.

name: Pre-Soak / Scarification
description: Soaking or nicking hard seed coats to accelerate germination. Common for beans, peas, morning glory.

name: Rhizobium Inoculant
description: Bacterial inoculant for legumes that enhances nitrogen fixation nodule formation.

name: Mycorrhizal Inoculant
description: Fungal spore coating that establishes mycorrhizal networks for enhanced root reach and nutrient uptake.

name: Kelp / Seaweed Soak
description: Soaking seeds in dilute kelp extract to boost seedling vigor and stress tolerance.
